query.queryString:
OperationalEventAccepted()
| where IngestedAtUtc > ago(2m)
| where
    Status in ("FAILED", "QUALITY_BLOCKED", "RECOVERY_REQUIRED")
    or Severity in ("ERROR", "CRITICAL")
| extend
    AlertDetectedAtUtc = now(),
    IngestionLatencySeconds =
        datetime_diff("second", IngestedAtUtc, EmittedAtUtc),
    DetectionLatencySeconds =
        datetime_diff("second", now(), EmittedAtUtc)
| project
    AlertDetectedAtUtc,
    EventId,
    ObjectRunId,
    CorrelationId,
    Environment,
    PipelineName,
    ObjectName,
    EventType,
    Status,
    Severity,
    ErrorClassification,
    EmittedAtUtc,
    IngestedAtUtc,
    IngestionLatencySeconds,
    DetectionLatencySeconds
| order by IngestedAtUtc desc
